requirements.requirement: The system must accept a minimum of 3 provider quality measures as input for score calculation.
The system must apply fixed, predefined weights to each input measure during score aggregation.
The system must normalize all input measures to a consistent scale before applying weights.
The system must compute a composite score as the weighted sum of normalized measures.
The system must produce identical output scores for identical input data across multiple executions.
The system must not use any randomization or non-deterministic functions in score calculation.
The system must return both the composite score and the weighted contribution of each measure.
The system must enforce that the sum of all weights equals 1.0 before performing calculation.
The system must reject input where fewer than 3 valid measures are provided.
The system must handle null or missing measure values by excluding them only if at least 3 valid measures remain.
The system must return an error response when normalization cannot be performed due to invalid input ranges.
The system must ensure all normalization and aggregation logic is implemented as pure functions without side effects.
The system must produce a composite score within a defined bounded range (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100).
The system must log calculation steps for debugging without altering the computed score.
